elapsed-time.boundary: Before first action delay through final successful push completion; includes all seven independent delays and action durations.
elapsed-time.undefined: Not produced as a completed trial if execution is interrupted; incomplete execution cannot establish criterion satisfaction.

completion-time.boundary: Before first action delay through final successful push completion; includes all seven independent delays and action durations.
completion-time.undefined: Not produced as a completed trial if execution is interrupted; incomplete execution cannot establish criterion satisfaction.

route-complete.undefined: Not produced as a completed trial if execution is interrupted; incomplete execution cannot establish criterion satisfaction.

remaining-energy.undefined: Not produced as a completed trial if execution is interrupted; incomplete execution cannot establish criterion satisfaction.

expectation.interpretation: Agent-side only; model emits measurements, not criterion verdicts.

preparation.controls_origin: Native gd controls --control-vars control-vars=game-design/control-vars --json; no overrides; source paths made example-relative.
preparation.checkpoint_policy: Actual future commit supplied at execution; this file does not name its own future commit.
preparation.coverage: One prescribed successful route; no insufficient-energy behavior, physical reachability, player performance or design verdict.
